purpose: Synthetic FR/EN runtime regression cases, including timeout recovery. Not a human-labeled quality benchmark.

cases.transcript: Before we publish the release please check that the application still works without an internet connection the microphone permission should only be requested when the user starts recording and we must not send any audio to an external service I would also like to compare the new decoder with the previous version using exactly the same recordings keep the original text whenever the correction is uncertain and do not replace unfamiliar names simply because another spelling looks more common
cases.expected: Before we publish the release, please check that the application still works without an internet connection. The microphone permission should only be requested when the user starts recording, and we must not send any audio to an external service. I would also like to compare the new decoder with the previous version using exactly the same recordings. Keep the original text whenever the correction is uncertain, and do not replace unfamiliar names simply because another spelling looks more common.

cases.transcript: I wanted to ask about the results actually before that can you check the test configuration because yesterday we used the small model and today we might be loading a different adapter the comparison would not be fair otherwise what I need is a table with the same audio files the same output constraints and separate measurements for cold startup and warm inference please keep the unsuccessful cases in the report as well
cases.expected: Please check the test configuration before comparing the results. Yesterday we used the small model, and today we might be loading a different adapter. I need a table using the same audio files and output constraints, with separate measurements for cold startup and warm inference. Keep unsuccessful cases in the report as well.

cases.transcript: Do not run npm publish open /src/auth.ts and run npm test with --no-cache the request timeout must remain 2500 milliseconds and the amount should stay 4500 euros not 5400 euros
cases.expected: Do not run npm publish. Open /src/auth.ts and run npm test with --no-cache. The request timeout must remain 2500 milliseconds, and the amount should stay 4500 euros, not 5400 euros.

cases.transcript: Dans la pull request garde le retry budget à 3 tentatives ne change pas le feature flag et vérifie que le cache de Qwen ne conserve pas les données de la session précédente ensuite lance npm test mais surtout pas npm publish
cases.expected: Dans la pull request, garde le retry budget à 3 tentatives, ne change pas le feature flag et vérifie que le cache de Qwen ne conserve pas les données de la session précédente. Ensuite, lance npm test, mais surtout pas npm publish.
